From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline onboarding: benchmark closure, evidence pack & acceptance

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for running the final load window with us yesterday. Attached is the consolidated evidence pack from the acceptance run we promised: a short PDF executive summary, the raw CSV output from the driver, and a couple of charts showing tail-latency and throughput steadiness.

Key highlights:
- Sustained throughput: 820 requests/s (95% of target) across a mixed prompt mix for the 30m steady window.
- Median latency: 78 ms; 95th: 210 ms; 99th: 420 ms (see tail-latency-99th.png).
- Cache hit rate (prefix caching): 37% which reduced token re-gen by ~18%.
- No error spikes; 5 transient 503s during a short autoscale event (we captured full traces).

Action requested for formal acceptance:
1) Confirm Greenline accepts the results against the acceptance criteria in section 2 of the PDF.
2) If accepted, please confirm sign-off by replying with the name/email of the authorized approver.
3) Confirm preferred date for the post-onboard review (30–60 minutes).

Notes on mitigations we already applied: we bumped the KV cache size for the session layer and pinched the immediate background autoscaler to prevent the brief 503 window from reoccurring. We've also captured logs and traces under the Drive link in the metadata.

Attachments: greenline-benchmark-summary-20270918.pdf, greenline-load-run-raw.csv, tail-latency-99th.png

Thanks — happy to walk through any chart detail live.

—Marcus

Thanks Marcus — useful packet and fast turnaround. Quick clarifications before we sign off:

- The acceptance doc lists a 99th latency target of <= 400 ms; our run shows 420 ms. Is that outside the negotiated tolerance or do we treat this as within a 5% buffer?
- Can you point to the timestamps for the 503s in the CSV so our infra team can correlate on our side?

If the 99th is formally outside, we need a short remediation plan before we sign. If it's within tolerance per Redwood's guidance, we can sign and proceed to the post-onboard review next week.

Also looping ops@greenline-retail.com for visibility.

—Sara Brooks
Head of Platform Engineering, Greenline Retail
Sara.Brooks@greenline-retail.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@greenline-retail.com>

Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Greenline onboarding: benchmark closure, evidence pack & acceptance

Hi Sara —

Short answer: we treat the acceptance window as having a +/-5% buffer on tail numbers when the run meets stability criteria (no sustained growth, no error rate >0.5%, and throughput within the agreed band). The PDF's section 2.3 defines the tolerance; I'll paste the excerpt below for convenience.

Excerpt (section 2.3):
"Acceptance is satisfied when the steady-state window meets throughput within +/-10% of the target and the 99th percentile latency is within the stated target +/- 5% given no correlated error/event during the window. Transient spikes caused by autoscaler cold-starts are assessed and may be excluded if documented and mitigated."

Based on our review, the 420 ms is marginally above the 400 ms target but within the 5% buffer. The three autoscaler-related 503s were short-lived and occurred at 10:12:17, 10:12:43, and 10:13:05 PST (full traces attached in the Drive link). We're comfortable recommending sign-off from Redwood's side.

Proposed next steps (short):
- Sara to confirm Greenline approval (authorized approver name) by EOD Mon 20 Sep.
- If approved, schedule post-onboard review the week of Sep 27 (we suggest Tue 28 or Wed 29, 30–45 minutes).
- We will open a small follow-up ticket to track the two optimizations we discussed (KV caching micro-tweaks and a routing table change); expected delta: reduce 99th by ~6–8%.

If Greenline wants a remediation run before sign-off, we can schedule a 1-hour window next Wed to demonstrate the optimizations.

Thanks — happy to be the Redwood approver contact.

—Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick review.

Per Monica's note, Redwood is comfortable recommending formal acceptance given the documented buffer and the transient nature of the autoscaler events. If Greenline is aligned, please reply with the approver name/email and we will:

1) Mark the onboarding as "Accepted" in HubSpot and attach the evidence pack.
2) Schedule the post-onboard review (I propose Tue Sep 28 10:00 PST; calendar invite to follow).
3) Open a follow-up implementation ticket (IMP-GL-229) for the two optimizations; owner: Marcus Lin.

If you prefer a short remediation run before sign-off, Marcus can book a 60-minute window tomorrow or Wednesday AM.

Looking forward to closing this out.
